en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square beside a river or canal. In the foreground are trees, a stone embankment, pedestrians, and horse‑drawn carriages. Behind them stand several 3–4‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs and shuttered windows, with shop signs at street level. One large corner building on the right carries the words "HOTEL BALNEAIRE" on its façade. On the hillside in the background are grand late‑19th‑century villas and larger apartment buildings; a church spire with a cross rises on the left.
